title: Darussan gyaran bidiyo
description: Gajerun jagororin ByteWave don haɗa bidiyo, rubutun magana mai motsi, tasirin rubutu, lambobi masu motsi, dishewar motsi da duba Content Credentials.
intro: Yi tsari, ƙara rubutun magana, sa lambobi motsi ko duba fayil. Gajerun jagororin kayan ByteWave.

cards.title: Layout daga ByteWave
cards.description: Jera guntayen bidiyo, gina grid ka gwada sababbin siffofi.
cards.alt: Tsarin saƙar zuma da bidiyon wata da kare

cards.title: Zaɓi tasirin rubutun magana
cards.description: Orbital Letters, Supernova, Ember Ash da ƙari.

cards.title: Shigo da font naka
cards.description: Yi amfani da font na TTF da OTF a rubutun maganar bidiyonka.
cards.alt: Font naka. Bidiyonka. Shigo da font na TTF da OTF a ByteWave.

cards.title: Sa lambobi su motsa da firam ɗin maɓalli
cards.description: Matsayi, girma, juyawa da firam ɗin maɓalli.

cards.title: Ƙara dishewar motsi a bidiyo
cards.description: Kwatanta sakamako gefe da gefe, nemo Motion Blur a edita ka daidaita ƙarfinsa don guntun bidiyonka.
cards.alt: Kwatancen bidiyon tashar jirgin ruwa: na asali a hagu, dishewar motsi ta ByteWave a dama.

cards.title: Sauya yawan firam don motsi a hankali
cards.description: Kwatanta guntun bidiyon hummingbird a gudun 0.1× ka ga yadda sauya yawan firam ke sauya motsin da aka rage.
cards.alt: Kwatancen hummingbird: rage gudu na yau da kullum na 0.1× a hagu, sauya yawan firam na ByteWave a dama.
cards.left: Rage gudu na yau da kullum · 0.1×

cards.title: Rage ƙurar hoto ta firam masu jere
cards.description: Kwatanta ƙurar hoto da ƙananan bayanai a bidiyon misalin Apple, sannan ka koyi abin da za ka duba a bidiyoyinka.
cards.alt: Misalin Apple na jajayen ganye: na asali a hagu, rage ƙurar hoto ta firam masu jere na ByteWave a dama.

cards.title: Duba Content Credentials na C2PA
cards.description: Buɗe tambarin asali ka koyi ma'anar tabbatattun bayanan samarwa da AI, kimantawar metadata da rashin shaida.
cards.alt: Duba Content Credentials a ByteWave: darasin asalin hoto da bidiyo.

cards.title: Cire metadata na wuri
cards.description: Duba kwafin bidiyon aiki, cire filayen da za a iya gyarawa ka duba abin da ya rage kafin rabawa.
cards.alt: San ƙari. Raba kaɗan. Duba ka cire metadata mai gyaruwa kafin raba bidiyonka.

cards.title: Fassara rubutun magana na bidiyo
cards.description: Mayar da rubutun magana na atomatik zuwa wani harshen da ake tallafawa, kwatanta na asali ka duba sakamakon kafin fitarwa.
cards.alt: Fassara rubutun magana na bidiyo. Mayar da rubutun magana na atomatik zuwa wani harshen da ake tallafawa, kwatanta na asali ka duba sakamakon kafin fitarwa.

cards.title: Sa tasiri ya amsa wa kiɗa
cards.description: Zaɓi matacin Sauti, kwatanta tsare-tsaren siffofi masu motsi ka duba amsawa a wuraren shiru da masu ƙarar sauti.
cards.alt: Sa tasiri ya amsa wa kiɗa. Zaɓi matacin Sauti, kwatanta tsare-tsaren siffofi masu motsi ka duba amsawa a wuraren shiru da masu ƙarar sauti.
